notes.note: Fix round 4 of the delivery-state change: another window's queue-change notice only re-projects (it no longer starts a flush, and a held copy listed from another window no longer counts as a waiting row); public outbox rows carry sendUnderWay only while the claiming renderer's Web Lock is held, so the list reads Sending only then and the bubble agrees; Discard… stays mounted and the shared confirmation takes and returns focus; the composer's confirmation opens as its own popover; the phone sheet's inline actions are a group of buttons; the accepted outbox note reads in sentence case and outbox text wraps and clamps to two lines. mobile-chat-composer.spec.ts gained the outbox-rows browser check at 390px and 1280px and its phone-sheet check now expects a group of buttons. The matrix row for mobile-chat-composer (composer reachability, mobile geometry) still describes the spec. No prose change.
